status: PROPOSAL - parameters set on one document family (Operations Summary tables of 5 documents of one report); generalisation NOT EVALUATED

deviation_k.unit: robust deviations (median/scale of the release family) by which a table margin may fall below the family median before the table is flagged

scale_floor_em.unit: em; lower bound of the family scale. Marks and header label are positioned independently, so print/measurement noise of 0.1 em on each gives a relative scatter up to 0.2 em; a family whose marks all sit at one offset (MAD = 0) must not flag that scatter

min_family_values.unit: margin values a release needs for a family distribution; below it the table gets an INFO signal and no judgement

mark_window_em.unit: em around the Non-Prod label span in which a lone mark glyph counts as a mark that left or reached the column

header_label.unit: text of the mark-column header word in the text layer

mark_glyph.unit: token that is a mark when it sits at the mark column

ignored_tokens.unit: tokens printed inside the mark column that are neither mark nor description

source_ref_prefix.unit: prefix of the table part source_ref written by the table rebuild

band_slack_pt.unit: pt added above and below the table part box when selecting words

max_listed_values.unit: per-row margins copied into signal evidence
